Select chat/tab/terminal/settings; files open editor, directories reveal tree; rename/pin/delete; Git ignored and content filters.

Stable query IDs, immediate invalidation, one asynchronous file worker plus latest pending request, stale descriptor rejection
Pin preferences commit before visible refresh; chat actions use existing save-conflict-aware lifecycle
Git ls-files cached/untracked with ignored toggle, case-insensitive content matching and UTF8/UTF16 decode, line navigation, derived real directories
Pinned physical root and ancestor handles, reparse exclusion, host ownership revalidation on selection
Modal keyboard navigation, copy URL without stealing selected input text, busy chat deletion guard, focus restoration
350x250 accessible compact filter menu, light/dark neutral selected rows
limitations: No source browser screenshot preview, tab pin/ownership reassignment menus, inline rename/delete confirmation presentation, or grouped section headings yet; existing native dialogs perform real actions.
Source ripgrep/frecency matching is represented by bounded Git listing/filename ranking and modified-time empty-query sort; content search uses literal case-insensitive matching.
Non-Git fallback is bounded filename scan and explicitly reports unavailable Git-ignore rules. Current fallback can only inspect its64 returned candidates for content.
At bounds, results are partial and status reports limits; checked elapsed caps do not interrupt a blocking OS filesystem call.
Only current native single-workspace-per-chat model; no multi-mount ownership parity.
Standalone renders exercise AppStyle/fonts and theme palette; host integration tests require root shared build. No whole-app pixel parity claim.
